funds_data.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in equity securities of small- and mid-capitalization companies. The fund's managers considers companies whose market capitalization, at the time of purchase, places them in the lowest 10% of the total market capitalization of the U.S. equity market to be small-cap and mid-cap companies.
